conventions.unit: EP-anchored ADR$ (compute_ep_adr_dollar on mi_daily_closes, EP-day close from the same table)
conventions.population: sessions elapsed after fire_date >= K in the extract; never settlement status; re-entry shapes pooled into their rung
conventions.control: every NON-FIRE session of the 20-session window after ep_date, for the campaigns where the pattern fired, entered at that session's close, same clock and abstain rules
conventions.bounds: pess = stop checked first on every bar; opt = target checked first
conventions.day0: daily-grade: whole fire-day bar folded; minute-grade: post-fire 5-min bars (real or cached pseudo bar) when available, else abstain if day low <= stop, else no day-0 event
conventions.price_scale: every fire-time input x dc_close(fire_date)/trigger.day_close (adjusted-history fix)
